article.headline: Stewart, Richmond take down Liberty 92-88 in double overtime
article.description: — Dominick Stewart scored 24 points and Richmond took down Liberty 92-88 in double overtime on Sunday.
article.linkText: Stewart, Richmond take down Liberty 92-88 in double overtime
article.story: WHITE SULPHUR SPRINGS, W.Va. -- — Dominick Stewart scored 24 points and Richmond took down Liberty 92-88 in double overtime on Sunday. Stewart shot 8 of 17 from the field, including 4 for 9 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line for the Spiders (4-3). Aiden Argabright scored 21 points, going 8 of 14 from the floor, including 0 for 3 from 3-point range, and 5 for 8 from the line. Amon Dorries shot 5 of 12 from the field and 6 for 6 from the line to finish with 16 points, while adding eight rebounds. Eli Sancomb led the way for the Flames (4-2) with 25 points, nine rebounds and two steals. Liberty also got 18 points and seven rebounds from T.J. Drain. Cooper Campbell finished with 16 points, six rebounds and seven assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
